No characters, no faces, no text. WREATH SHEET: a ring-shaped wreath made of eight to ten big flat overlapping paper maple and oak leaves in bold saturated colours: crimson red, deep orange, golden yellow and plum-magenta, with a few small dark-red berry dots and three or four tiny loose leaves spilling slightly outside the ring. Each leaf casts a soft real shadow on the leaf beneath it. The wreath is only a ring: its centre is a large empty open oval filled with solid flat magenta, and the area outside the ring is also solid flat magenta. The background outside the cut shape is one flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF with no texture and no shadow, so it can be keyed out; no glow and no outline.
